name: automation-skill
description: Wire it across systems you don't own — then reconcile what you can't un-send

interface.shortDescription: Wire it across systems you don't own — then reconcile what you can't un-send
interface.longDescription: Faceted-router skill for building business processes that span systems you do not own: 12 primary jobs (reconciliation, integration reliability, compensation and recovery, credentials and connections, approval and authority, trigger design, sync semantics, workflow observability, cost and quota, platform selection, workflow testing, process capture) across 4 base surfaces (hosted iPaaS, self-hosted engine, code-first durable execution, platform-native) plus an additive agentic overlay. Reconciles against the vendor's authoritative state rather than the system's own record of what it told it, treats compensation as a forward action rather than a rollback, and defaults to a solo/small-team posture where independence comes from the source, the clock, or a pre-committed rule rather than a second approver.
defaultPrompt: Use $automation to design a Stripe-to-CRM sync that survives a missed webhook.
